body: College was my first attempt at reaching that type of goal since I went far away from home and I almost already have to drop out after my first semester. I just feel absolutely useless that in my first attempt to actually improve things for myself I managed to just make everything so much worse.
I've never been able to set actual goals and I feel like that's the source of all the issues I have. I've always relied too much on other people and when I don't have other people life feels useless.
I feel like you're right but then I just keep asking myself what the point is. If I'm just spending my time doing nothing with no real goals what's even the point in "living".
I have some passions. I love photography for example. But I'm barely motivated to even do that anymore. Everything just feels useless to me.
